_about: Shared by tests/run.js (the web app) and android/app/src/test (the Android app). Both must accept every valid file with the same result, reject every invalid one, and write the same readable record. androidBackup is what the Android app writes; the web app must restore it. Visits, names, reminders and place are written only by the Android app; the web app must keep them.

valid.why: a backup downloaded from the web app
the bare state older web versions wrote
a newer backup with fields this version does not know yet
